transitions.when: Target is valid AND NOT Reset AND next Count < Target
Target is valid AND NOT Reset AND next Count >= Target

state_machine.transition_rule: For valid Target and NOT Reset, calculate next Count=min(pre-scan Count + (1 if rise else 0), Target) before selecting Counting or Complete. Clamp on every scan, including scans without a rising edge. States are descriptive; no state transition delays output updates.

priorities: Invalid Target overrides Reset and counting; Error remains TRUE when both invalid and Reset are present.
For a valid Target, Reset overrides counting and clears Count and Complete.
Sample and update pulse edge memory on every scan, including invalid-target and reset scans.
Use the declared USINT Target interface: valid values are 1 through 20. Reject Boolean or non-integer values at any external adapter rather than coercing them.

scan_execution_order.name: Edge sampling
scan_execution_order.actions: Sample inputs once; calculate rise=PartPulse AND NOT previous_pulse using the retained pre-scan value, then unconditionally set previous_pulse to the sampled PartPulse.

scan_execution_order.name: Safety/reset priority and state transitions
scan_execution_order.actions: Validate Target, apply invalid-target and Reset priorities, and calculate next Count, Complete, and Error using the pre-scan Count and sampled inputs. Select the descriptive state in the same scan.

scan_execution_order.name: Unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF
scan_execution_order.actions: No timers are required; this stage performs no calls.

scan_execution_order.name: Unified output assignments
scan_execution_order.actions: Assign Count, Complete, and Error once from their calculated next values. The assigned Count is retained for the next scan.

formal_assertions.formula: G((!PartPulse & X(PartPulse) & X(!Reset & Target >= 1 & Target <= 20)) -> X(Count) = min(Count + 1, X(Target)))
G(((PartPulse | X(!PartPulse)) & X(!Reset & Target >= 1 & Target <= 20)) -> X(Count) = min(Count, X(Target)))
